          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else (sum(for x in [application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip] return if x = null then 0 else x) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and not(application.collateral.purchasePrice = null) and not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.fixedPreference">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly = null then null else if application.income.grossMonthly <= 0 then null else ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan.amount = null then null else if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) > 0 then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else if application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">

        </inputEntry>

        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">

        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income != null and application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 and application.housing != null and application.housing.principalInterest != null then (application.housing.principalInterest + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>

          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly = null or application.income.grossMonthly <= 0 then null else (sum([if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest, if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes, if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance, if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa, if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip]) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>

testSuite.description: A null value for incomeStability prevents the ARM7/1 rule from matching.

testSuite.name: Fixed30 - Priority Over ARM
testSuite.description: Even if ARM criteria are met, if fixedPreference is true, Fixed30 is chosen (Rule 2 precedes Rule 3).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 and application.housing.principalInterest != null then ((application.housing.principalInterest + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false then 0 else (if d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0)))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100) else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan.amount != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then (application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100) else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>

        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI is 50.1, which exceeds 50.

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV is 95.1, which exceeds 95.

testSuite.name: Fixed30 - Fixed Preference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Fixed30 - High Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity.

testSuite.name: ARM7/1 - Perfect Match
testSuite.description: All conditions for ARM 7/1 are met, including boundary values.

testSuite.name: No Product - Below ARM Score
testSuite.description: Score is 719, which is below the 720 required for ARM.

testSuite.name: No Product - High Horizon
testSuite.description: Horizon is 8 years, which exceeds the 7 years allowed for ARM.

testSuite.name: No Product - Variable Income
testSuite.description: Income stability is variable, which fails ARM criteria.

testSuite.name: No Product - High LTV for ARM
testSuite.description: LTV is 81, which is above the 80 limit for ARM.

testSuite.name: Precedence - Manual over Fixed
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Manual Review) takes priority over Rule 2 (Fixed30) even if fixed preference is true.

testSuite.name: Precedence - Fixed over ARM
testSuite.description: Rule 2 (Fixed30) takes priority over Rule 3 (ARM7/1) even if ARM conditions are met.

testSuite.name: Null DTI - ARM Match
testSuite.description: DTI is null, so Rule 1 is not triggered; other ARM conditions are met.

testSuite.name: Null Score - No Match
testSuite.description: Credit score is null, making Rule 1 and Rule 3 conditions unmet.

testSuite.name: Boundary - Exact Manual Thresholds
testSuite.description: Score 640, DTI 50, and LTV 95 are at the limit but do not trigger Rule 1.

testSuite.name: Ambiguity - Floating Point Credit Score

Виконуються умови ARM7/1, але fixedPreference=true → очікувано: Fixed30

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий DTI
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо dti > 50)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)
Фіксована перевага + кредитний бал 600 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + DTI 55 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + LTV 97 → відсічка переважає

Висока чутливість до ставки + LTV 98 → відсічка переважає

Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 75 → відсічка переважає

Кредитний бал рівно 640 → не відсічка (умова «нижче 640»)
Кредитний бал 639 → відсічка
DTI рівно 50 → не відсічка (умова «вище 50»)
DTI 50.5 → відсічка
LTV рівно 95 → не відсічка (умова «вище 95»)
LTV 95.1 → відсічка
Умови ARM, кредитний бал рівно 720 → ARM7/1 (умова «щонайменше 720»)
Умови ARM, кредитний бал 719 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, LTV рівно 80 → ARM7/1 (умова «80% або менше»)
Умови ARM, LTV 80.5 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, горизонт рівно 7 років → ARM7/1 (умова «сім років або менше»)
Умови ARM, горизонт 7.5 року → жодне правило
Умови ARM, горизонт 8 років → жодне правило
fixedPreference = null, решта нейтральна → жодне правило
Умови ARM, але creditScore = null → жодне правило (умова не виконана)
Фіксована перевага, DTI = null → Fixed30 (відсічка за DTI не спрацьовує)
Умови ARM, але incomeStability = null → жодне правило
rateSensitivity = null, фіксованої переваги немає → жодне правило
Кредитний бал 610 при rateSensitivity = null → ManualReview
Короткий горизонт і стабільний дохід, але LTV 85 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, але змінний дохід → жодне правило
Середня чутливість, без переваги, довгий горизонт → жодне правило
Висока чутливість до ставки, fixedPreference = null → Fixed30
Фіксована перевага, кредитний бал рівно 640 → Fixed30 (відсічки немає)
Базовий профіль ARM7/1 (горизонт 6, LTV 75, бал 740, DTI 30)
ARM7/1 з горизонтом 3 роки, бал 810, DTI рівно 50
